title: pithecellobium nitidum
intro: Pithecellobium nitidum, commonly known as the "Brazilian ironwood" or "Brazilian coral tree", is a species of flowering tree in the pea family (Fabaceae). The health benefits of Pithecellobium nitidum include its potential to help manage conditions such as diabetes, hypertension, and inflammation, due to its antidiabetic, vasodilatory, and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Pithecellobium nitidum include antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory actions, attributed to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of Pithecellobium nitidum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and coumarins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
